before.question: Instead of writing 35/6 as a decimal correct to 3 significant figures, a student wrote it correct to 3 places of decimals. Find his error in standard form
before.ai_explanation: 35/6 = 5.8333...; to 3 significant figures = 5.83; to 3 decimal places = 5.833; error = 5.833 - 5.83 = 0.003 = 3.0 × 10⁻³.

records.source_repair: Restored superscripts and clarified that the requested error is the difference between the two rounded values. Retained B; explained why numerically equal A does not meet the requested notation.
records.explanation: 35/6 = 5.8333… rounds to 5.83 at three significant figures and 5.833 at three decimal places. Their difference is 5.833 − 5.830 = 0.003 = 3.0 × 10⁻³. Standard form requires a coefficient from 1 up to, but not including, 10. Option A has the same numerical value but is not written in the requested standard form.

before.subject: mathematics
before.question: Make y the subject of the formula Z = x2 + 1/y3
before.ai_explanation: From Z = x² + 1/y³, rearranging gives 1/y³ = Z - x², so y³ = 1/(Z - x²), thus y = ∛(1/(Z - x²)) = (Z - x²)^(-1/3).

records.source_repair: Restored the complete stacked denominators for every option and added the required nonzero denominator condition. Corrected D to C.
records.explanation: Subtract x² to obtain Z − x² = 1/y³. Taking reciprocals gives y³ = 1/(Z − x²), so y = 1/∛(Z − x²). This requires Z ≠ x². A cube root does not distribute over subtraction: ∛(Z − x²) is not generally ∛Z − ∛(x²).
